component.name: Backdrop
component.script:
sub init() m.hello = m.top.findNode("hello") m.time = m.top.findNode("time") m.ampm = m.top.findNode("ampm") m.date = m.top.findNode("date") m.icon = m.top.findNode("icon") m.temp = m.top.findNode("temp") m.cond = m.top.findNode("cond") m.range = m.top.findNode("range")
m.clock = m.top.findNode("clock") m.clock.observeField("fire", "tick") m.clock.control = "start" tick()
m.fetch = CreateObject("roSGNode", "WeatherTask") m.fetch.observeField("result", "onWeather") m.fetch.control = "RUN" end sub
sub tick() now = CreateObject("roDateTime") now.ToLocalTime() h = now.GetHours() mins = now.GetMinutes() h12 = h mod 12 if h12 = 0 then h12 = 12 mm = mins.ToStr() if mins < 10 then mm = "0" + mm m.time.text = h12.ToStr() + ":" + mm if h >= 12 then m.ampm.text = "PM" else m.ampm.text = "AM" months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"] m.date.text = now.GetWeekday() + ", " + months[now.GetMonth() - 1] + " " + now.GetDayOfMonth().ToStr() if h >= 5 and h < 12 then m.hello.text = "Good morning," else if h >= 12 and h < 17 then m.hello.text = "Good afternoon," else if h >= 17 and h < 22 then m.hello.text = "Good evening," else m.hello.text = "Good night," end if end sub
sub onWeather() w = m.fetch.result if w = invalid or w.temp = invalid then return c = w.code day = (w.day = true) kind = "cloud" text = "" if c = 0 then if day then kind = "sun" text = "Clear and sunny" else kind = "moon" text = "Clear" end if else if c <= 2 then if day then kind = "part" else kind = "cloud" text = "Partly cloudy" else if c = 3 then text = "Cloudy" else if c <= 48 then kind = "fog" text = "Foggy" else if c <= 57 then kind = "rain" text = "Drizzle" else if c <= 67 then kind = "rain" text = "Rain" else if c <= 77 then kind = "snow" text = "Snow" else if c <= 82 then kind = "rain" text = "Showers" else if c <= 86 then kind = "snow" text = "Snow showers" else kind = "storm" text = "Thunderstorms" end if m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/wx-" + kind + ".png" m.temp.text = w.temp.ToStr() + Chr(176) if w.place <> invalid and w.place <> "" then text = text + " in " + w.place m.cond.text = text if w.high <> invalid then m.range.text = "High " + w.high.ToStr() + Chr(176) + ", low " + w.low.ToStr() + Chr(176) end sub
